fin_shortage.news: A fin shortage: the ring series bought every grippy fin on the dock. Fin prices are up, and sellers are smiling.

engine_glut.news: A freighter unloaded a hold full of drives. Engines are cheap this week.

cockpit_fad.news: Picture windows are in fashion. Everyone wants a new cockpit, and the prices show it.

lights_sale.news: The lamp-makers' guild is clearing stock. Lights are going cheap.

gadget_craze.news: Race gadgets are the talk of the dock. Prices for them have gone silly.

brass_compass.name: Brass pocket compass
brass_compass.desc: It points at the nearest teapot. Tested twice.

lucky_washer.name: Lucky washer
lucky_washer.desc: Someone engraved it with a tiny horseshoe. Holds nothing together, very luckily.

comet_glass.name: Comet-glass marble
comet_glass.desc: A marble of fused comet ice. It glows faintly when Bramble rises.

racing_pennant.name: Old racing pennant
racing_pennant.desc: QUIETWATER CLUB RACE, CHAMPION. The year has been scratched out, carefully.

tin_robot.name: Tin wind-up robot
tin_robot.desc: It walks three steps, waves, and falls over. Brindle would love it.

moon_plum_pit.name: Petrified moon-plum pit
moon_plum_pit.desc: Allegedly from the first moon-plum on the dock. Allegedly.

halloran_spanner.name: Halloran's tiny spanner
halloran_spanner.desc: A spanner the size of a pencil, initialled H. For very small arguments.

snow_globe.name: Ring snow globe
snow_globe.desc: Shake it and tiny ice moons drift around a tiny Bramble.

mixtape.name: Pilot's mixtape
mixtape.desc: Labelled SONGS FOR GOING FAST. Side B is just engine noises.

fossil_bolt.name: Fossil bolt
fossil_bolt.desc: A bolt so old it's turned to stone. Still the right thread, somehow.
